name: io.github.tonyyang0504/teamtailor-mcp
description: Teamtailor (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMTAILOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Teamtailor API key with the Public scope (read), created at https://app.teamtailor.com/app/settings/integrations/api-keys; sent as `Authorization: Token token=<key>`.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEAMTAILOR_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Teamtailor API host for the account's data stack: api.teamtailor.com (EU stack) or api.na.teamtailor.com (NA stack).
